name: Enhanced Volume Data Set (EVDS)
definition: An Enhanced Volume Data Set (EVDS) is a volumetric representation where, in addition to the value assigned to every vertex (voxel) of the grid, selected edges between vertices are given a Boolean label: 1 for active edges and 0 for inactive edges. This provides basic connectivity information about whether two vertices sharing a common active edge belong to the same underlying object.
summary: Enhanced Volume Data Sets augment voxel grids with Boolean edge labels to encode local connectivity, separating segmentation from geometric modeling for efficient topological analysis.
